An Ordinance to amend the Code of Ordinances of the City of McIntyre, Georgia, to govern the rules for garbage pick up.

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF MCINTYRE, GEORGIA,

THAT the owner or lessee of every house, building or property used for human occupancy, employment, recreation or other purposes situated within the city or in any area under the jurisdiction of the city, receiving city of McIntyre water service and abutting on any street, alley or right-of-way shall be required to use the garbage pick up service provided to the citizens by the City of McIntyre.

Each location specified above shall receive a charge for garbage pick up on their monthly water bill.

All ordinances or parts of ordinances in conflict with this Ordinance are. to the extent of such conflict hereby repealed.

SO ORDAINED this day of May 2017.
